name: Expanded Storage
desc: Deeper spiral coils. Every slot holds 8 units instead of 4.

name: Faster Restocking
desc: A rear-loading hatch. Restock while a customer waits, and it costs 2 minutes instead of 12.
effect: Restock during customers; 2 min instead of 12

name: Improved Machine Lighting
desc: Brighter, warmer tubes behind the glass. Reflections are clearer and the dark feels further away.

name: Enhanced Security Monitor
desc: Adds CAM 4 (Route 9 shoulder) and a sharper night-vision mode that annotates movement.
effect: Unlocks CAM 4 and extra camera observations

name: Customer Identification Tool
desc: A handheld scanner Meridian 'does not officially supply'. Reads pulse, temperature and something labeled RESIDUE.
effect: Adds the SCAN inspection to every customer

name: Emergency Power Backup
desc: A battery bank under the counter. When the lot goes dark, the machine and monitor stay on.
effect: Blackouts are shorter and the machine keeps working
